purpose: Teach: 一撃/行財政/主審/官民/裏づけ/等価/定型/総勢

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、創業時、業界に一撃を与える商品を出された
lines.en: Your father — when he founded the company, he released a product that shook the entire industry.
lines.style: Warm, measured reminiscence. Soft eye contact. The pace of someone choosing words carefully, honoring the memory. Slight pause before each detail, like turning a page.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは行財政の知識も豊富だった
lines.en: Yes. He had a deep knowledge of business and public administration too.
lines.style: Calm affirmation. Not defensive, not eager — just confirming what was true. Steady voice. The tone of someone who lived alongside that knowledge.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、業界コンペで主審を務められた
lines.en: Your father — he served as a judge in the industry competitions.
lines.style: Gentle, almost tender. The voice lifts slightly with the memory. A slight catch, like missing him. Quiet and deliberate, not rushing the image.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは官民連携の懸け橋になられた
lines.en: Yes. He became a bridge between public and private sectors.
lines.style: Reflective, with quiet pride underneath. Not boastful — just acknowledging what his father built. Steady breath. Words that land like stones in still water.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、データの裏づけを必ず確認された
lines.en: Your father — he always verified the data behind decisions himself.
lines.style: Tender but precise. The admiration is in the specificity — he's remembering the care, the diligence. Slight emphasis on 'always.' Voice trails gently, like a quiet lesson.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは社員に等価な機会を与えられた
lines.en: Yes. He gave his employees equal opportunity to advance.
lines.style: Steady and clear. There's weight in this statement — it was deliberate, not accidental. Not lecturing, but honoring what mattered. Breath sits underneath the words.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、定型作業の改善にも熱心だった
lines.en: Your father — he was deeply committed to improving even routine work.
lines.style: Tender specificity. The voice finds warmth in the smallness of it — not just the big moves, but the care for daily things. Gentle and unhurried. Soft trailing-off.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは総勢千名の社員を率いられた
lines.en: Yes. He led a company of a thousand people across all departments.
lines.style: Quiet, grounded closure. The finality of the number — a thousand lives touched. Voice is steady but not grand. The tone of someone at peace with what was built and carried forward.
